feedback.answered: The promoted-leader variant of the confirmed recovery finding reproduces in a local construction run: with the recovering replica having IsLeader true and maxRecvBallot 5, startRecoveryForInstance makes ballot 6 and reports it as the replica's own VBallot (seed_lb_ballot -1, record_vbal_reported_by_self 6), the peer's COMMITTED reply at vbal 0 is skipped (adopted_committed false), the accept round completes (accept_oks 0 to 1), the recoverer commits NOOP while the peer keeps PUT (vectors_match false, all_committed_match false for replica0 NONE, replica1 PUT, replica2 NONE) and the applied state diverges (peer 04 against (void)). So the deployed variant, where the master promotes one replica to leader, shows the same masking; IsLeader only raises the ballot further, which leaves the comparison unchanged.
remaining: fixing that observation as a formal check needs a plan whose claim grounding, harness legality and monitors all reference the same binding that the candidate supplies in the same submission; attempts that referenced an existing binding were rejected as nonselected, and attempts that referenced only the new binding were rejected as unavailable, so the accepted shape for a fresh obligation's bindings needs one more attempt
